key.category.basicchestsearch.title: Basic Chest Search
text.autoconfig.basicchestsearch.title: Settings
If enabled, the search text is preserved when closing and reopening a container.
Automatically focuses the search bar when opening a container.
Detaches the search bar from the inventory window.
Choose between 'SORT' (hides non-matching items), 'DARKEN' (dims non-matching items), or 'DISABLED' (no search bar).
